issues.description: The method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents has conflicting return types in the problem statement: the task text requires it to return a String formatted as "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", but the UML diagram declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void. The solution implements it as returning String, so students following the UML would implement an incompatible signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML diagram in problem_statement.md to declare +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String (instead of void) so it matches the task text and the intended implementation.
